test_title: PYST 32: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 22 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a function under the Twelfth Schedule of the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Foreign trade promotion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Twelfth Schedule of the Constitution of India:** The Twelfth Schedule was added to the Constitution through the **74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992**. It contains a list of **18 functions** assigned to Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
 
• These functions relate to urban governance and development, empowering ULBs to manage various aspects of urban infrastructure and services.
 
• **Public health:** This is one of the functions listed under the Twelfth Schedule. Urban local bodies are responsible for ensuring sanitation, healthcare facilities, and controlling diseases within urban areas. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*
 
• **Urban poverty alleviation:** This function involves efforts to reduce poverty in urban areas, providing support through employment programs, housing schemes, and basic amenities for underprivileged groups. *Hence, statement 3 is correct.*
 
• **Urban planning:** Urban planning is a core function under the Twelfth Schedule. It includes designing and implementing plans for land use, infrastructure development, and urban growth management. *Hence, statement 4 is correct.*
 
• **Foreign trade promotion:** This is not a function under the Twelfth Schedule. Promoting foreign trade is a responsibility of the central government and related ministries such as the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Urban local bodies do not have a role in this area. *Hence, this is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Twelfth Schedule Functions:**

 
 
• The Twelfth Schedule lists functions related to urban governance such as **water supply, sanitation, urban forestry, slum improvement, regulation of land use, public health, and solid waste management**.
 
• Urban Local Bodies are empowered to manage these functions for efficient urban administration and development.
 
 
 
• **Foreign Trade Promotion:**
 
 
• Foreign trade promotion is managed by agencies such as the **Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT)** under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 
• It involves policies and initiatives to boost India's exports, develop trade relationships, and negotiate international trade agreements.
 
• **Example:** Schemes like the **Export Promotion Capital Goods (EPCG)** scheme aim to encourage exports by reducing duties on imported goods used in production.
 
 
 
• **Urban Planning and Development:**
 
 
• Urban planning is a critical function of ULBs, focusing on land use management, infrastructure development, and sustainable growth.
 
• **Example:** Smart City Mission launched by the Government of India to improve urban infrastructure and provide better services.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **74th Constitutional Amendment Act:**

 
 
• This amendment introduced provisions for democratic decentralization and urban governance.
 
• It mandated the establishment of Urban Local Bodies like municipalities, municipal councils, and municipal corporations.
 
 
 
• **Empowerment of Urban Local Bodies:**
 
 
• The Twelfth Schedule empowers ULBs to manage functions critical to urban development, ensuring better governance and public service delivery.
 
• **Example:** Functions like water supply, sanitation, and urban forestry directly impact the quality of life in cities.
